args.subject: Acknowledgement of open lines at current price, ahead of 15 October
args.body:
Dear Heather Lindqvist,

Thank you for your notice of 9 September about the price change from 1 November. Please acknowledge our five open lines below at the current price, as your notice describes for orders acknowledged by 15 October, and confirm the promised dates shown.

One of these lines was already past due on 25 September (marked below).

HPO-26-00548/50 · Corner bracket, 40 series (HR-72130) · 721 EA · promised 24 August (past due)
HPO-26-00675/10 · HR-72101 · 70 EA · promised 25 September
HPO-26-00675/30 · Extrusion, 40x80 T-slot (HR-72104) · 260 EA · promised 28 September
HPO-26-00675/40 · Extrusion, 80x80 T-slot (HR-72120) · 200 EA · promised 26 October
HPO-26-00675/20 · Extrusion, 40x40 T-slot (HR-72103) · 400 EA · promised 23 November

For HPO-26-00548/50, please also give us a shipping date as soon as you can.

For any coming need, please tell us whether the current price holds for orders placed by 15 October.

This acknowledgement request does not change the terms of the orders, and Halden reserves all of its rights under them.

Please reply by 15 October.

Best regards,
Tom Albrecht

actions.subject: Past-due PO line HPO-26-00548/50: ship date please
actions.body:
Dear Heather Lindqvist,

One line on our orders with you was past due on 25 September and we have no updated promise date:

HPO-26-00548/50 · Corner bracket, 40 series (HR-72130) · promised 24 August (past due)

Please give us a ship date for this line as soon as you can.

On your notice of 9 September about the price adjustment effective 1 November: please acknowledge our five open lines at today's price, by 15 October. They are HPO-26-00548/50 (721 EA, Corner bracket, 40 series, HR-72130, promised 24 August, past due), HPO-26-00675/10 (70 EA, Extrusion, 40x40 T-slot (HR-72101), promised 25 September), HPO-26-00675/30 (260 EA, Extrusion, 40x80 T-slot, HR-72104, promised 28 September), HPO-26-00675/20 (400 EA, Extrusion, 40x40 T-slot, HR-72103, promised 23 November) and HPO-26-00675/40 (200 EA, Extrusion, 80x80 T-slot, HR-72120, promised 26 October). For our coming need, please also tell us whether today's price holds for orders placed by 15 October. Please reply by 15 October.

Best regards,
Tom Albrecht
Halden Robotics
